name: Suspension Y-Fly
steps: Face a suspension trainer anchor, grip both handles with palms down, and lean back with straight arms and a rigid body.
Keep your elbows straight and brace your core firmly from head to heels.
Raise both straight arms diagonally upward and outward into a wide Y overhead while pulling your body upright.
Control the straps smoothly as you lean back down to the starting position without letting tension go slack.
tips: Keep the straps taut at the top rather than swinging forward past vertical into slack straps.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and squeeze your shoulder blades together as your arms form the Y.
